name: Will my business insurance cover commercial sewage cleanup costs?

mainEntity.name: Will my business insurance cover commercial sewage cleanup costs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Commercial property insurance policies often cover water damage, but coverage for sewage backups can vary. Typically, if the backup is caused by an issue *within* your property's plumbing system (e.g., a burst pipe), it may be covered. However, if the backup originates from the municipal sewer system, it often requires a specific sewer backup endorsement or rider to your policy. It's essential to review your specific policy or contact your insurance provider to understand the extent of your coverage for sewage-related incidents and potential deductibles.
acceptedAnswer.description: Coverage for commercial sewage cleanup depends on your specific insurance policy; some instances may be covered, but municipal sewer backups often require a special endorsement.
